generator.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: clean environment background plate, no characters, for a bounded game stage. Create exactly one new native 3840 x 2160 PNG, 16:9, with no enlargement from a smaller image. Primary subject: L2 logistics loading yard in an abandoned infected-city freight depot. Expansive covered exterior industrial loading area with a tall warehouse canopy overhead, sturdy weathered steel trusses, one broad closed corrugated roll-up door on the back-left wall, a wide empty raised concrete loading platform, and a few scattered closed plain unmarked wooden shipping crates at the far perimeter. Crates must be fully closed opaque boxes, with no visible contents and no labels; small neutral set dressing, never a hero loot chest. No large central crate. Camera from the empty yard looking beneath the canopy towards warehouse frontage, wide architectural 28 mm at human eye level, stable level perspective, realistic scale. Most of the lower center and the middle 60% of image width must remain open clear floor and platform so a later battle or action UI can be composited; no essential objects cut at image edges, peripheral boxes may be cropped. Show the broad rolling-shutter silhouette and warehouse roof structure within the central 60% safe region. Dense tactile realistic detail in steel seams, oxidized metal, worn concrete, structural bolts, old drainage channels, subtle damp ground reflections; detailed cinematic game illustration with sober desaturated blue steel and teal-black shadows, low warm tungsten industrial lamps under the canopy, weak cold overcast ambient light. Readable dark midtones, no cartoon, no fantasy, no heavy blur, no dramatic tilt. The yard should be recognizable as a logistics loading facility and distinct from a hospital. Absolutely no characters, humans, zombies, bodies, shadows resembling people, enemy, forklift driver or vehicle. No text, lettering, numbers, signage, labels, brand, hospital references, HUD, UI, interface frame, icon, watermark. No exposed mechanical component, extraction part close-up, obtainable material, open crate, medical supplies, glowing loot, quest item or reward. No dedicated interaction station or success indicator. The image is an unpopulated visual background, not an assertion that canonical L2 has no enemy; no guaranteed search reward or new gameplay route is implied. Deliver one full-bleed native 3840x2160 PNG background.
